newsitem.title: USA: Integrated authorizes $1 mln stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Integrated authorizes $1 mln stock buyback.

text.p: Integrated Technology USA Inc said Thursday that its board of directors has authorized it to repurchase up to $1 million worth of the company's common stock in the open market.
It said that the timing of any repurchases and the number of shares actually repurchased will depend on a variety of factors, including price and other market conditions.
The company said there are presently 6,068,212 shares of its common stock outstanding, and that as of of March 1 it had cash and cash equivalents of approximately $13.5 million.
